newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Boulevard sees steep growth by 1998.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Boulevard sees steep growth by 1998.

text.p: Philippines' Boulevard Properties Holdings Inc is projecting substantial growth in its net income by fiscal year 1997/98 to 49.965 million pesos from a measly 1.753 million pesos in the previous fiscal year ended May 1996, company officials said on Monday.
Boulevard is one of the 13 companies in the consortium which won the right to develop a 214-hectare tract of land at the edge of Manila's Makati business district.
Treasurer Alfredo Joaquin told reporters that income from its several projects were going to pour in by the end of this year.
Revenues would grow to 78.016 million pesos in 1997/98 from 3.299 million pesos in 1995/96. Revenues for 1996/97 would reach 52.262 million pesos, Joaquin added.
Boulevard is selling 500 million shares, or 50 percent of the company, to the public at one peso per share.
The offer period starts on March 31, while listing date is tentatively set on April 28.
With a net asset value (NAV) of 1.76 pesos per share, the offer price of 1.00 peso per share represents a 43 percent discount to NAV, underwriter PNB Securities Corp, said in its report.
